name: Equipment capability 设备能力
rule: Equipment type and precision must satisfy method requirements

name: Tester qualification 人员资质
rule: Assigned tester must have required qualification

name: Calibration status 校准状态
rule: Equipment must be operational and calibration valid during the scheduled period

name: Resource conflict 资源冲突
rule: Equipment, person and required space cannot be double-booked

name: Working calendar 工作时段
rule: Task must fit resource working hours unless overtime is explicitly allowed

name: Pre-processing dependency 前处理依赖
rule: Required prep space must be available before instrument task starts

name: Waiting time 等待时间
rule: Minimize time between request readiness and scheduled start

name: Load balance 负载均衡
rule: Avoid concentrating work on one instrument or tester

name: Switching cost 切换成本
rule: Reduce method changeover and setup time
